cases.name: neg-disclosure-envelope-ineligible
cases.description: DE-1 rejects a member outside the disclosure-eligibility table

cases.name: neg-disclosure-envelope-mismatch
cases.description: Disclosure Envelope whose agent_input disclosure does NOT recompute to the committed digest (same capsule as pos-disclosure-envelope-match, tampered disclosure value): DE-3 reports disclosure_mismatch and the envelope's ok is false, while the wrapped capsule's own capsule_id recomputation and Class 1 result are unchanged and still ok — a bad disclosure never gates the capsule's own verification.

cases.name: neg-disclosure-envelope-no-commitment
cases.description: DE-2 requires the matching committed digest field

cases.name: neg-disclosure-envelope-uncanonicalizable
cases.description: DE-3 reports an uncanonicalizable disclosure as mismatch

cases.name: pos-disclosure-envelope-both-fields
cases.description: both disclosure-eligible fields match, reported in deterministic member order

cases.name: pos-disclosure-envelope-match
cases.description: Disclosure Envelope whose agent_input disclosure recomputes to the digest committed in model_attestation.compute_attestation.agent_input_digest: DE-3 reports disclosure_match, and the wrapped capsule's own capsule_id / Class 1 result is unaffected and still ok.
